n12dfa364dc.summary: Gold has dropped nearly 6% from last week's peak. Commentary says Fed repricing and technical support near $4,300 point to a correction rather than a reversal.
n12dfa364dc.why: Gold is a traditional store of value and a hedge against inflation and currency risk, and its price is sensitive to expectations for US interest rates.

nc600a9de80.headline: Oil jumps above $90 per barrel after fresh US-Iran strikes
nc600a9de80.summary: Oil prices climbed more than 2% on Monday amid renewed US-Iran tensions following a US strike on Iranian forces. Prices moved above $90 per barrel.
nc600a9de80.why: Brent crude is the international benchmark for oil, and supply risks in the Middle East directly affect its price.
nc600a9de80.why_moved: Renewed tensions between the United States and Iran followed a US strike on Iranian forces, raising supply-risk concerns in the oil market.

ne75c0eb99c.headline: IVF provider sees new life in stimulated cycle numbers
ne75c0eb99c.summary: A fertility services provider reported a sharp fall in net profit after fewer patients started new treatment. The company was not named in the input.

n0c42cd76a3.headline: No end in sight for 'celeb bait' Facebook ad battle
n0c42cd76a3.summary: Meta is under continued scrutiny over a flood of scam advertisements on its platforms, including 'celeb bait' ads. The article reports no regulatory outcome.
n0c42cd76a3.why: Meta owns Facebook and Instagram, and regulatory action over ad content could affect its advertising revenue and compliance costs.

n80756e3e79.headline: One Nation turns up election heat with energy pitch
n80756e3e79.summary: A populist party has promised to extend the life of a coal-fired power plant as part of its energy policy pitch ahead of an election.
n80756e3e79.why: Energy policy on coal and power supply affects electricity prices and the outlook for generators and industrial users.

n814aed790c.headline: US and Iran Exchange Fire for First Time Since Start of Economic Operation
n814aed790c.summary: A US drone reportedly struck Larak Island in the Strait of Hormuz, according to preliminary reports from Tasnim News Agency. It is the first exchange of fire since the economic operation began.
n814aed790c.why: The Strait of Hormuz is a critical oil transit route, so military incidents there can quickly affect energy markets.

n7056bde941.headline: First Impressions: NZ Business Confidence, August 2026
n7056bde941.summary: Business confidence was slightly lower in the August ANZ Business Outlook survey after rebounding near pre-conflict levels. Global oil prices rose again after hostilities resumed in early July, but pump prices were relatively muted.
n7056bde941.why: Business confidence surveys are leading indicators of investment and hiring, and New Zealand's economy is closely watched by regional currency markets.

n971b28a354.headline: Iraq PM Chairs Meeting on Strategic Export Pipeline Projects | Iraq Business News
n971b28a354.summary: A meeting chaired by Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi reviewed technical and economic details of the Basra-Haditha pipeline and the Haditha-Baniyas pipeline. The projects are designed to export crude oil.
n971b28a354.why: Iraq is a major OPEC crude producer, and new export pipelines determine how much oil it can ship without relying on the Gulf route. Pipeline capacity affects regional supply.

nef707e71da.headline: 'We're going to hit them hard', Trump vows retaliation

n7e6209ef2f.headline: Star Entertainment warns tough conditions to persist after annual loss | Company Business News

n7e6209ef2f.why: Star Entertainment operates casino resorts in Australia, and its results reflect conditions in the local gaming and tourism market.

ne5ba8a70dc.headline: Welcome to the 'United States of Makati,' where family income is PH’s highest – and most unequal
ne5ba8a70dc.summary: Makati recorded the country's highest average family income at P796,990 in 2025. Families in its top 10% earned nearly eight times as much as those in the bottom 10%.
ne5ba8a70dc.why: Income distribution data shapes consumer spending and the outlook for property and retail demand in the Philippines' business districts.

n7ac084cc54.headline: Cryptos Fall As Crude Oil Prices, Rate Hike Bets Rise
n7ac084cc54.summary: Cryptocurrencies mostly declined over the past 24 hours as markets priced in higher Federal Reserve rate hike expectations after hawkish comments from the Fed Chair. Crude oil prices also rose.
n7ac084cc54.why: Crypto assets are sensitive to liquidity conditions and interest rate expectations set by central banks such as the Federal Reserve.

n47b84eca1d.headline: MongoDB heads into Q2 print with AI upside still unproven
n47b84eca1d.summary: MongoDB reports second-quarter earnings Tuesday, with investors watching for AI-native customer demand in the numbers. The cloud-hosted Atlas segment is on track for a fifth straight quarter of 29-30% growth.
n47b84eca1d.why: MongoDB is a database software company whose cloud Atlas service is a key indicator of enterprise demand for data infrastructure tied to AI.

n0f964f0a23.headline: Govt drains emergency fund to extend fuel tax hike delay

n0f964f0a23.why: Fuel taxes feed into transport costs and inflation, and government fiscal buffers matter for New Zealand's sovereign credit profile.

n996a45b727.headline: India exceeds expectations! GDP grows 7.8 percent: these are the main drivers of the economy

na0e13208c9.headline: Trump invites the Russian Finance Minister to the G-20 Economic Meeting in North Carolina …..

na0e13208c9.why: G-20 finance meetings coordinate global economic policy, and participation by sanctioned countries shapes sanctions policy and international finance diplomacy.

nf114e28f78.headline: Who is running in Israel’s 2026 election? A guide to the major parties | The Jerusalem Post
nf114e28f78.summary: Israel's first post-October 7 election features shifting alliances, new political faces and an uncertain path to power, according to a guide to the major parties. Economic policy implications are not detailed.
nf114e28f78.why: Israeli election outcomes shape government policy on the economy, defense spending and the shekel, and affect investor sentiment toward Israeli assets.

n71b0dac893.headline: AI-driven cyber risk is top concern for global financial stability, watchdog says
n71b0dac893.summary: In a letter to G20 finance ministers and central bank governors, Bank of England governor Andrew Bailey said many countries lack systems to manage deployment of advanced AI models. AI cyber risk is a top stability concern.
n71b0dac893.why: The G20 coordinates global financial policy, and regulators' cyber and AI oversight shapes bank and fintech compliance costs.

n993a79ee1a.headline: United Arab Emirates says it has intercepted an Iranian drone over its territorial waters
n993a79ee1a.summary: The UAE's air force intercepted an Iranian drone over its waters on Monday, its Defense Ministry said, after the US and Iran exchanged fire over the weekend.
n993a79ee1a.why: Attacks near Gulf states threaten shipping and energy infrastructure that underpin global oil and gas supply.

n6c1986e2d0.headline: Iran fires missiles at US sites in Jordan; UAE intercepts Iranian drone after strikes

n6c1986e2d0.why: Jordan hosts US forces and sits near key Middle East transit routes, so strikes there raise regional security and energy-risk premiums for investors.

nbafaff36d4.headline: US strikes Iran for first time in weeks as Tehran vows retaliation
nbafaff36d4.summary: The United States and Iran have exchanged attacks for the first time in several weeks, sharply escalating tensions around a strategic region, with Tehran vowing retaliation.

n67108328af.headline: China reins in rising yuan as weak domestic demand clouds outlook
n67108328af.summary: China is slowing a long rally in the yuan and is likely to keep further gains to a minimum this year, market participants say. Authorities are stepping in to support exporters.
n67108328af.why: The yuan's exchange rate influences China's export competitiveness and global capital flows, and affects investors holding yuan-denominated assets.

n0be0c28cb7.why: The Strait of Hormuz is a critical chokepoint for global oil flows, so naval incidents there can affect crude supply and freight costs.

n0f580f3aec.headline: Tanker struck by three projectiles exiting Strait of Hormuz, UKMTO warns
n0f580f3aec.summary: UKMTO reported that a tanker was struck by three unknown projectiles about 17 nautical miles east of Khasab, Oman, while outbound through the Strait of Hormuz. No casualties were reported.

n4bcad4c4c3.why_moved: Renewed US-Iran fighting raises the risk of supply disruption in a region central to global oil flows.
